transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I decided to come in today because I know for a fact that I am being monitored and targeted by a group of people. I can constantly feel them watching my every move, even when I'm inside my own home. It’s becoming very difficult to live with this constant surveillance, so I need some help.
Have you also had periods of feeling unusually energized or irritable with much less need for sleep, or periods of feeling very depressed or hopeless?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. My mood has been pretty stable, and I don't get unusually energized or deeply depressed. It's really just the stress of being watched all the time that I'm dealing with.
Have you noticed any hallucinations, like hearing voices when no one is around, or seeing things other people don’t see?

No, I have never experienced anything like that. I don't hear any voices or see things that aren't there. My senses are perfectly fine; it's just the actual physical monitoring that I am dealing with.
How long have you been feeling monitored and targeted, and has this belief been present for at least one month?

This has been going on for exactly two years now, so it has been much longer than just a month. It started back in the spring of two years ago, and there hasn't been a single day since then where they haven't been watching me.
Aside from this belief, have you been able to keep up with work, relationships, and daily activities pretty much as usual?

Yes, I've been able to keep working and managing my daily routines without any real issues. Aside from the stress and anxiety that comes directly from being monitored, my relationships and day-to-day life have remained pretty normal. I can still do everything I need to do; it's just exhausting carrying this burden around.
This presentation is most consistent with Delusional Disorder. Thank you for answering my questions.

Thank you for your assessment and for taking the time to listen to my situation. Since you believe it is Delusional Disorder, what are the next steps we should take? I would like to know what kind of treatment options are available to help me manage this stress.
